name: 川西竹舍
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-screen painterly mobile game BACKGROUND ART only.
Primary request: 川西竹舍 — an outdoor bamboo forest picnic in mountain country at sunny morning, a fresh landscape composition with real perspective and depth.
Canvas: TALL PORTRAIT 720:1520 ratio, no phone frame, image fills all edges. Camera tilted gently downward across the picnic ground while still seeing the green forest and mountain stream beyond.
Scene composition: Irregular lush bamboo trunks rise diagonally at varied heights and depths around the outer left and upper-right thirds, glowing translucent fresh green leaves in dappled golden morning light. A slender winding stone path and clear shallow stream recede toward distant soft green Sichuan mountains in the upper third. A LARGE honey-yellow woven bamboo picnic mat is laid diagonally over the ground, extending from midframe across the middle/lower 70% of the scene, with a visible diagonal rolled edge near lower-left, a small woven picnic basket partly cropped in the far bottom-right corner and a few bamboo leaves beside it. Mat is an integrated ground surface with perspective and fine low-contrast weave, not a vertical wall or bordered panel. Sunlit soft natural bamboo weave and a broad simple quiet central area for later tile cards.
Game-overlay legibility: the background behind a future tile cluster in horizontal x21-75%, vertical y34-57% must be low contrast, clean, simple golden mat weave with no objects or hard shadows crossing it. Keep the broad y74-83% mat surface quiet for a future tray and y91-97% quiet for future controls; do not draw any tray or controls. Foliage and rich texture concentrate at outer periphery and distant upper third.
Style: premium high-detail handpainted casual mobile game illustration with tactile physical materials, beautifully modeled 3D depth and soft painterly edges, inviting saturated jade/lime green + golden honey mat + warm earthy ground, natural dappled light. This must be a full outdoor forest landscape, asymmetrical picnic scene with visible depth, NOT the usual decorative wallpaper layout.
Absolute constraints: no text, no lettering, no logo, no icons, no UI, no tiles, no food sprites, no actual food dishes, no frame, no borders, no foreground pot. NO fabric curtains/swags, NO paired lanterns, NO room/interior, NO paper wall, NO symmetric vases/pedestals, NO roof, NO wooden tabletop or horizontal tabletop horizon. Do not put a blank rectangular wall or paper in the center. No people. Single complete background illustration.
firstAttemptIssue: Furthest mat edge began around y35%, leaving small scenic detail behind the top card row.
revisionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: referenced tall outdoor bamboo picnic background. Preserve its excellent fresh green bamboo forest, distant mountain stream, golden morning light, diagonal woven bamboo mat, left lower rolled edge and lower-right basket.
CRITICAL SPATIAL FIX ONLY: Tilt the camera farther downward and extend the picnic mat farther away, upward in the composition. The furthest TOP edge of the mat must lie at 28% of total image height; all the area below y29%, especially the whole x21-75%,y34-57% rectangle, must be uninterrupted fine low-contrast honey-gold woven bamboo mat. Keep all forest, path, stream, rocks and distant mountains compressed in upper 27% and extreme side edges. The mat should still be diagonal with perspective, grounded naturally outdoors, its far edge not looking like a vertical wall. Mat weave behind the future central cards must be subtle and uniformly light. Keep gorgeous lush bamboo trunks at upper-left/outer edge, mountain/stream distance above the mat, small cropped basket lower-right and rolled mat edge lower-left. Maintain high-detail polished painterly casual game quality. Preserve tall portrait 720:1520 aspect.
No text, logo, UI, tile cards, tray, buttons, food sprites, pot, lanterns, fabric curtains, room, roof, paperwall, tabletop or rectangular central panel. Single complete outdoor illustration.
